## Transcrição

00:00 Back to the original question for this module: What options do you have for building an AI project or an ML model?
00:07 Do you have the answer now?
00:09 If not, let's take a quick look.
00:13 Google Cloud offers a wealth of options to suit your needs, whether you're a business user, data scientist, developer, or ML engineer.
00:21 These range from no-code, out-of-the-box solutions to low-code tools and even code-based DIY approaches.
00:30 You've been introduced to Agent Platform, Google's unified AI platform, which serves as your ultimate workspace for exploring these options and building end-to-end machine learning projects.
00:43 You've specifically focused on: Agent Platform AutoML, a fantastic low- or no-code tool within Agent Platform
00:51 that automates ML development from data preparation to model training and serving, all using your own data.
00:58 Pre-trained APIs: Ready-made solutions that leverage powerful pre-trained machine learning models, completely eliminating the need for any training data.
01:08 Custom training: This empowers you to manually code ML projects using versatile tools such as Python, JAX, and Agent Platform Workbench.
01:19 Given all these exciting options, how do you build an ML model step-by-step on Agent Platform?
01:26 Let's uncover the answer in the next module.
